summary: Accomplished senior manager with over 15 years of experience leading complex projects and managing resources to optimize enterprise technology and support business objectives. Subject matter expert in Information Security Risk Management, adept at bridging functional groups and technology to foster innovative solutions.

experience.title: Director of Information Technology and Analytics
responsibilities: Directed global IT strategy for a credit asset management firm with $4B AUM.
Established security policies and Sarbanes‑Oxley compliance framework.
Managed a 6‑person team overseeing infrastructure, network, security, and disaster recovery.
Led cross‑functional project teams through full lifecycle and technical escalation.
Implemented DLP, advanced threat protection, and next‑generation firewalls.
Chairman of cybersecurity committee, developing incident response and breach rehearsal plans.
Oversaw procurement, deployment, and support across Dallas, Baton Rouge, Shanghai, Dublin, London, Singapore, and Tokyo.
Designed and executed disaster recovery and business continuity strategies.

experience.title: Information Technology Manager
responsibilities: Directed hardware and software configuration, installation, and support for a manufacturing firm.
Administered network infrastructure, cabling, and telecommunications platforms.
Managed vendor relationships and service provider contracts.
Monitored service metrics and led change request management.
Led Windows 2003 migration, Cisco VPN, and Exchange 2003 deployments.
Planned and implemented ERP and disaster recovery initiatives.

experience.title: Systems Administrator
responsibilities: Supported 250 client nodes in a Windows NT environment.
Upgraded to Windows 2000 and maintained DNS, WINS, DHCP.
Managed 85‑node development server environment.
Engineered System Management Server 2.0 and Symantec Ghost imaging.
Performed daily network monitoring, backups, and log checks.

experience.title: Data/Systems Administrator
responsibilities: Managed daily data downloads from distributors and uploaded to SQL databases.
Maintained Windows FTP servers and performed hardware/software upgrades.

projects.name: DLP Solution Deployment
projects.description: Evaluated and deployed Symantec Data Loss Prevention system, creating escalation procedures aligned with data governance policies.

projects.name: Virtual Computing Environment Deployment
projects.description: Led the deployment of a high‑performance virtual computing environment to support new internal development models.

projects.name: Advanced Threat Protection Implementation
projects.description: Designed, implemented, and maintained an advanced threat protection system, including next‑generation firewalls and mobile computing security.

projects.name: Data Governance and Classification Policies
projects.description: Created data governance and classification policies for personally identifiable information, integrating with incident response frameworks.
